messages.content: this is an updated design md file please replace the old one

Replaced `design/design.md` with the new merged version (adds Soft Grey light theme, paired token tables, §3 theme system, §5–§9 modal/menu/filter patterns, §20 component addenda; corrects module count to 46 and permissions to single-list-on-role).

Two things worth flagging from the new doc that touch other files you'll want to keep aligned:

1. **CLAUDE.md still says "3 tiers"** (Core/Pro/Enterprise) — new design.md §12 point 4 says "5 subscription tiers." One of them is stale. Want me to reconcile?
2. **Old `design/tokens.css` and `Styles.txt`** are now explicitly superseded ("This file replaces the old `design.md` + `Styles.txt` (now merged)"). Delete them, or leave as legacy references?
